Changes.note: “Deste aç” opens a deck for this course; it is opened in your name and the course’s staff (everyone holding deck.manage_course) run it. With “Taslak olarak kaydet” the talebe do not see it; “Yayımla” opens the deck to the talebe enrolled in (or done with) the course, and “Taslağa çek” takes it from them but keeps their progress. A card you add reaches the talebe at once if the deck is published. Only the person who opened the deck can edit or delete an existing card; the other staff members’ attempts fail. “Desteyi sil” deletes a draft deck and its cards for good, and only a draft; it cannot be undone.
